# Paths excluded from secret scanning.
#
# These test files intentionally contain synthetic, non-functional
# credential-shaped strings (fake GitHub/AWS/Stripe/Slack/JWT tokens) used
# solely to prove that scripts/lib/redact.mjs correctly masks real secrets
# before they are persisted or displayed. None of these values are real
# credentials, and none were ever valid. See RELEASE_READINESS.md.
#
# Regex patterns, matched against the repository-relative file path.
^plugins/krylo/tests/hooks/fingerprint\.test\.mjs$
^plugins/krylo/tests/hooks/risk-gate\.test\.mjs$
^plugins/krylo/tests/security/injection\.test\.mjs$
^plugins/krylo/tests/status/statusline\.test\.mjs$
^plugins/krylo/tests/unit/cli\.test\.mjs$
^plugins/krylo/tests/unit/redact\.test\.mjs$
^plugins/krylo/tests/unit/state\.test\.mjs$
